findings.one_line: The proposed fixed, observable complete SI-PAG calculus with faithful opposing witnesses is replaced by a conditional implication that assumes both universal faithful realization and the unknown-A opposing-extension property; no rule list, canonical equality, or confidence SI-PAG result is delivered.

The ExactID target remains an endpointwise universal quantification over the compatibility fiber: the core supplies neither an instantiated finite rule system nor another computable recovery map from the oracle signature, while expressly leaving that construction open.
